code='''from collections import deque
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] not in (0,3)]
    color=grid[seeds[0][0]][seeds[0][1]]; q=deque(seeds); seen=set(seeds)
    while q:
        i,j=q.popleft()
        for di in (-1,0,1):
            for dj in (-1,0,1):
                ni,nj=i+di,j+dj
                if (di or dj) and 0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w and grid[ni][nj]==0 and (ni,nj) not in seen:
                    seen.add((ni,nj)); out[ni][nj]=color; q.append((ni,nj))
    return out
'''
